title: Phase 3 — Tối ưu session & token
summary: Plan to reduce per-task token use by summarizing .gsd context, forking sessions, and handing over long sessions, measured against Phase 2 SQLite data.
notes: No ADR signals (no Status field, no Context/Decision/Consequences structure, no numbered ADR filename). No user stories or 'as a user' language. Dominant signals are technical design: a sessions table schema, file templates, approach comparison table (A/B/C), and a token threshold. Acceptance-criteria table (P3-01 to P3-06) and task checklist are PRD-like but secondary. Classified as SPEC with medium confidence. Output filename omits the source_hash suffix because no hashing tool was available to the classifier; the synthesizer should key on source_path.
